video_meta.title: Who Really Drives Better? Men vs Women (The Data Might Surprise You)
video_meta.description:
Everyone has an opinion on who's the better driver — men or women. We dug into real insurance data, crash statistics, and studies to find out where this idea actually comes from, and whether it holds up.

Subscribe for more fun, fact-checked deep dives every week!

#drivinghabits #menvswomen #didyouknow #factcheck

scenes.narration: Here's the twist: men are involved in about seventy two percent of fatal car crashes.

scenes.narration: Women, on the other hand, are slightly more likely to have minor fender-benders, but far less likely to cause serious harm.
